lastCompletedStory.title: Wire preflightWorkerContainer() into the dispatch decision point (result available, gates nothing live)

nextStoryContext: US-001 through US-005 are complete. US-005 (B-1) wired preflightContainerFn as an OPTIONAL dep on RunSupervisorOptions (loop.ts). The dep calls preflightWorkerContainer() before the respawn-pane dispatch and logs the PreflightResult via logEvent as a 'container-preflight' event. The host spawn is UNCHANGED (B-1 is observe-only). Production wiring in host.ts uses real spawnSync('docker', ...) as the probe and statSync as statFn. US-006 (B-2, CAM-152) is the next story: it should flip this fail-closed using escalateFn when preflight is not-ready. The injectable seam (preflightContainerFn) already exists as the extension point.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docker CLI docs page did not document exit codes for 'docker image inspect' when image is missing. Implementation relies on empirically known behavior: exit 0 when image exists, non-zero otherwise. preflight-container.ts was already unit-tested in prior story.
